title: scorzoneroides laciniata
intro: Scorzoneroides laciniata, commonly known as Laciniata or Cut-leaved Scorzoneroides, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine due to its purported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, pain, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Scorzoneroides laciniata include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit hepatoprotective effects, and exhibit anticancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
